name: Donately
description: Donately is an online fundraising platform for donation forms, campaign pages, peer-to-peer fundraising, recurring giving, donor contacts and integrations.
agentUseSummary: Add a Donately account ID and API token, choose which agents may use the connection, and run all 38 operations in the official API v2 reference. Relay pins the 2022-12-15 version and exact account; Safe runs 20 reads directly and requires approval for 18 mutations.

credentialRequirements.label: Donately account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the act_-prefixed account ID. Relay binds every request to it with the Donately-Account header.

credentialRequirements.label: Donately API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the API token from Dashboard, Settings, API. Relay encrypts it and uses it only as the username in HTTP Basic authentication to api.donately.com.

capabilities.label: Read fundraising data
capabilities.description: Use all 20 documented Donately API v2 reads.

capabilities.label: Manage fundraising data
capabilities.description: Use all 18 documented Donately API v2 mutations.

allowed.label: Read Donately
allowed.description: Read account, campaign, donation, subscription, person, fundraiser, form and webhook data.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Donately
approvalRequired.description: Create, update, refund, charge, resend, default or delete authorized Donately resources; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 20 reads run directly; all 18 mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 38 documented API v2 operations run without Relay per-action approval; account binding, fixed routes, audits, bounds and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts all 38 documented Donately API v2 operations with fixed account/version headers and server-side Basic authentication.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires an authorized Donately account, its act_-prefixed account ID, API token and representative fundraising records; this code-only worker has none of them.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator stores the account ID and API token through Relay Console, then validates current-account binding, representative reads and approved reversible mutations, token replacement, token deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: Donately documents the fixed API v2 origin, token-as-Basic-username authentication, account scoping, date-version header and 38 current account/campaign/donation/subscription/person/fundraiser/form/webhook operations.
Donately's official developer hub identifies its API reference as the complete REST API documentation for authentication, endpoints, filtering and pagination.
Donately's privacy policy expressly covers use of api.donately.com and personal information processed through the platform API.
